evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2020-01-01"} returned 201 with dueDate "2020-01-01". POST with {"title":"nodate"} and no dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The date is a plain calendar date with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/2 with {"dueDate":"2030-05-05"} returned 200 and the new date. PATCH with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null, so the date was removed.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "01/02/2026" and "abc" each returned HTTP 400. PATCH with "2026-02-30" and "nope" each returned HTTP 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-11-01. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the todo with dueDate 2020-01-01 that was not done. The todo due today (2026-11-01), the todo with no date, the todo with its date removed and the done todo with a past date were all excluded, and each showed overdue:false. ?overdue=false returned the other four. The unfiltered list returned all five.
evidence.AC5: The list page at / showed 2020-01-01 for 'past', 2026-11-01 for 'today' and 2020-01-01 for 'pastdone'. The todos with no due date showed no date.
evidence.AC6: In the page snapshot only the not-done todo with the past date had the text 'überfällig'. The today, no-date, cleared-date and done-with-past-date todos had no marker.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled 'nur überfällige'. After clicking it, the list showed only the 'past' todo with 2020-01-01 and überfällig.
